mappings.basis: Both units assert that ferry tickets are refundable, each with one disjunct of the condition folded into the assertion text; a reader would take each as making T1's assertion. Both have evidence [0,28], the target quote.

mapping_doubts.note: Units 1 and 2 are each narrower than the target (condition folded into the assertion: 'if the sailing is cancelled' / 'if the passenger is ill'). Mapped direct under M3; listed both under M5 as independent restatements.
